title: Secured Card Graduation Review Points, Personal Credit Cards
content:
Of the six tiers of Personal Credit Cards, graduation figures are carried by the secured tier alone: the months after opening at which the account is reviewed for graduation, and the tier it graduates into.

| Tier | Months after opening at which graduation is reviewed | Tier graduated into |
|---|---|---|
| Secured Visa | 8 | Cash Rewards Visa |
| College Rewards Visa | not applicable | not applicable |
| Platinum Low Rate Visa | not applicable | not applicable |
| Cash Rewards Visa | not applicable | not applicable |
| Travel Rewards Visa Signature | not applicable | not applicable |
| Visa Infinite Private Client | not applicable | not applicable |

The review point of 8 months and the destination tier, Cash Rewards Visa, are figures of Secured Visa; every other tier records both as not applicable.
